provenance.report_policy: Each source was hash-verified against the DEVELOPMENT source manifest before parsing. Reports were generated into ephemeral temporary directories and byte-identical on repeat replay; report JSON hashes are recorded and the generated files were not retained.
provenance.join_policy: Source-first locators were paired to report relations using the existing v1.2 DEVELOPMENT join rule; source labels remain authoritative.

summary.source_valid_false_candidate_expected_ou: No candidate after selecting and recording the local denominator; fail closed if v1.3 cannot establish its provenance.
summary.zero_numerator_expected_outcome: Identify denominator-selection failure. Select the source-local denominator with provenance before arithmetic, or fail closed; never validate solely because 0% coincides.

correct_local_denominator_evidence.derivation: Medical-record N=55 minus 22 missing sex records = 33 observed records. The displayed category counts independently sum to 6 + 27 = 33.
correct_local_denominator_evidence.scope_interpretation: The medical-record percentage denominator is variable-specific complete cases. The Missing row states 22 missing sex values and 23 missing injury-type values; N=55 is the full sample, not the non-missing denominator.
correct_local_denominator_evidence.v1_3_scope_decision: Available-case base is reconstructed from missing-count/category evidence and is not an explicit denominator candidate under v1.3.

expected_v1_3_outcome.fallback: Do not reconstruct or select an available-case base from missing counts or category totals; do not perform arithmetic.
